description: Modify the recipe hydration and update logic to preserve existing recipe slugs when loading from the database. Only regenerate slugs when the recipe name actually changes during updates, not during hydration. Add test coverage to ensure slugs remain stable across hydration cycles and only update when necessary.
functional_requirements: When hydrating Recipe models from the database, preserve the existing slug value instead of regenerating it
Only regenerate the recipe slug during update operations when the recipe name field has actually changed
Ensure recipe updates that don't change the name maintain the existing slug value
Add unit tests to verify slug preservation during model hydration from database records
Add integration tests to verify slug behavior during recipe updates with and without name changes
Maintain backward compatibility with existing slug generation logic for new recipes and name changes
